div.ab: Henricus (Dei gratia) rex Anglorum Samsoni episcopo et Ursoni de Abetot et omnibus baronibus suis, Francis et Anglis, de Wirecestrescira salutem.
Henricus (Dei gratia) rex Anglorum, Samsoni episcopo et Ursoni de Abetot et omnibus baronibus suis Francis et Anglis de Wirecestrescira, salutem.
Henry, [by the grace of God] King of England, to Bishop Samson and Urso d'Abetot and all his barons in Worcestershire, both French and English—greeting.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 524, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
